probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Salto&Pan ® Growth agency for online shops and software companies Services Case studies Pricing About Overview Buy Kotei Overview Buy Kotei Services Case studies Pricing About Blog Free audit Contact We started because agency reports didn't add up. Salto&Pan is a team of 22 in Valencia and Copenhagen. We run growth for online shops and software companies, and we answer to one number: the revenue in your own books. Our story Two offices and one rule about reporting, since 2019. Elena Marín ran growth at two online shops before starting the agency. Both times, she hired agencies that sent long reports full of clicks and impressions, while sales stayed flat. In 2019 she started Salto&Pan with one rule: we only report numbers a finance team would recognise. Revenue from the shop, cost per new customer, return on everything spent, including our fee. Mikkel Sørensen joined a year later to run paid media and opened the Copenhagen office. Giulia Ferri came from engineering to lead search. Today we're 22 people working with 40 clients across Europe, the UK and the US. Founded in Valencia 2019 People across two offices 22 Clients on retainer 40 Revenue driven
